method: Read only process names, process identity, /proc task comm and wchan, and per-thread CPU counters for existing training descendants. No process command lines, environment, process memory, decoding, or profiling attachment.

source_flags.decoder_option_scope: -threads 1 appears before -i and configures input decoding; it does not cap total operating-system threads.
source_flags.interpretation: Filter, encoder, demuxer, muxer, and scheduling infrastructure can create additional operating-system threads. Filter-named pools are observed but their exact internal origin cannot be proved from thread names.

limitations: One instantaneous snapshot; CPU counters are cumulative since thread creation, not interval percentages.
Sleeping ancillary threads at this instant may run later in a clip.
Short-lived processes may exit while inspected; captured thread list can be partial.
Does not modify or decode data; captures only already-running descendants.
